name: resu-studio
description: Resu Studio, from CX Instruments. Tools for the person applying for the job rather than the employer screening for one.

plugins.name: resu-studio
plugins.description: Tailor a CV and cover letter to one job advertisement, honestly. Scores what the advertisement asks for against what the person has actually done, proposes every change as current text, suggested text and a reason for them to accept or reject one at a time, and prints a finished PDF exactly as the studio shows it.
